capabilities: parse conventional commit subjects from a selected editor range
group subjects by type with scopes and BREAKING labels
route unparseable lines to a visible Review section
preview and save the draft as a new vault note
configure custom type headings and named templates (Pro)
disambiguation: Does not run Git or create commits; it drafts release notes from pasted commit subject lines.
extras: Freemium: core grouping is free; Pro (custom headings, up to 20 named templates) requires a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors sponsorship and OAuth sign-in. No network requests until sign-in and no telemetry. README warns mobile, Windows, and Linux sessions were not tested.
problem: Turning a list of commit subjects into grouped release notes normally requires Git, a terminal command, or a release service; Obsidian has no built-in tool for this.
summary: Release draft builder that parses selected conventional commit subjects from a note and saves a grouped Markdown release report.
